title: sieve-native/evaluator: extract_match_type uses filter with side-effects
description: crates/sieve-native/src/evaluator.rs extract_match_type() and extract_comparator() — use Iterator::filter with a closure that mutates external state (mt, cmp). This is a code smell: filter is expected to be a pure predicate; callers inspecting the code must realize the filter is also performing assignment. The conventional Rust idiom is to use a for loop with explicit push to the remaining vec, or to use partition. extract_comparator additionally has a skip_next flag making the stateful filter even harder to follow.
